# FLX-7133: the query process was ended: the queries passed their time

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

The queries of a run may take their seconds each (limits.seconds, 30 at most unless --max-query-seconds raises it), and the whole batch may take the sum of those plus 30 seconds. A query that passes its own seconds is interrupted and takes the status timedOut. A batch that passes the sum is a process that has stopped answering, so the engine ends it, first with a request to stop and then by force, and counts nothing. Run the command again; if it repeats, lower the work the queries do or raise --max-query-seconds.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7133
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
